jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Pelico 
 Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.
 We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.
 Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.
 This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.
 About the Role 
 Pelico is hiring a Senior Product Manager — Core Platform to own one or more of the shared components that every Pelico product is built on.
 Pelico is moving from features built per use case to a platform of configurable components: the data model and the engines that compute on it, the configuration layer, UI building blocks, workflows and actions, and the platform services around them. Solution teams, forward deployed engineers and AI agents combine these components to deliver a use case for a customer. The quality of that base decides how fast Pelico delivers, how well it scales and whether customers trust what they see.
 You will own part of that base and run it as a product. Its users are internal teams and agents as much as planners and buyers at customer sites. The exact scope depends on your profile and the team's needs. The role is technical: you need to discuss data structures, APIs, performance and configuration models as easily as user workflows.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Own one or more platform components end to end. Depending on the team's needs, this can be the data model and how customer data maps into it, the computation engines, the configuration layer, configurable UI building blocks (tables, detail views, dashboards), the action library and write-back to customer systems, or platform services such as access control and notifications.

 Treat internal teams as your customers. Understand what solution PMs, forward deployed engineers and the agent team need, and turn repeated requests into reusable components instead of one-off builds.

 Make components configurable, not custom. Decide what is configured, at which level (common, solution, customer), and where custom code is still acceptable. Cut the time it takes to deliver a new use case.

 Design for agents as well as people. Give components clear interfaces so workflows and AI agents can call them as tools, with audit, limits and approvals.

 Hold the bar on scale, reliability and trust. Enterprise data volumes, near real-time updates, on-prem and sovereign deployments, security reviews. Performance, correctness and explainability are product requirements.

 Stay close to customers. Spend time with users and deployment teams at strategic accounts to see where the platform helps them and where it gets in the way.

 Keep the platform coherent. Work with the other platform PMs and with design on shared vocabulary, data contracts and dependencies, so components fit together.

 Run the roadmap. Write specs, set priorities with the tech lead, ship on the release train, and measure how other teams adopt your components and what it changes for customers.

 
 About You 
 Product management: 5+ years as a PM in B2B software, including time owning a platform, infrastructure or developer-facing product used by other teams.

 Technical fluency: comfortable with data models, APIs, configuration systems and performance trade-offs. You can read a technical design, challenge it and write acceptance criteria engineers can test.

 Platform judgment: you know when to generalize and when not to, and you can turn down a one-off request while keeping the requester on your side.

 Data rigor: you can query data, trace an odd output back to its source and size the impact of a change across customers.

 Enterprise B2B experience: you know what large customers require on security, deployment and change management.

 Domain curiosity: interest in manufacturing, supply chain or industrial operations, and the will to learn how a plant runs.

 Cross-functional leadership: you lead engineers, designers and other PMs through decisions without formal authority.

jobs.title: Finance Transformation Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join Qonto as a Finance Transformation Project Manager, based in Paris, and take full ownership of high-impact, cross-functional initiatives — from analyzing current gaps to selecting providers, implementing new processes, and driving adoption across Finance. Your work will directly shape how Qonto’s Finance functions at scale.
 You will work closely with your Finance Transformation peers and Core Finance, Strategic Finance, Product and Tech teams. You will be in the details of our processes and tools, while keeping the big picture in sight.

 ➡️ What you'll do 
 Own your projects end to end: frame the scope, build the plan, governance and risk tracking, and coordinate the delivery.

 Diagnose our current processes and tools: in relation to your project scope, map the flows end to end, use data to find pain points and compliance risks, and turn them into a prioritized roadmap within your project plan.

 Choose the right solution: define requirements, run build-or-buy analysis, run RFPs or assess our existing tools when relevant, and recommend the best option, whether that means improving what we have, building in-house or selecting a new solution.

 Build and roll out hands-on: work shoulder to shoulder with the business teams, Product Owners and system experts on configuration, integrations and testing, then drive adoption across the teams concerned.

 Steer cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority: run the project rituals, anticipate risks, arbitrate trade-offs and keep leadership updated on progress and blockers.

 ➡️ What we're looking for 
 Project leadership: you have led finance transformation or systems projects end to end (framing, delivery, adoption) for 6+ years, and you drive Finance and Tech teams within your project scope without hierarchy.

 Hands-on and systems-minded: you map processes yourself, analyze data and test solutions with Tech instead of only writing specs. You are comfortable with finance tools and data flows (ERP, purchase-to-pay or procurement tools such as Coupa).

 Finance process know-how: you can map finance flows from purchasing to payment and accounting, spot dependencies and design pragmatic, compliant solutions.

 Structured problem-solving: you diagnose with data, run tool selections or RFPs, and turn recommendations into changes that stick.

 Clear communication & stakeholder management: you are able to influence across teams and present complex topics simply to any audience.

 Qonto fit: you connect with our culture and with how we work: autonomy, customer satisfaction at the core, and collaboration across teams. You are fluent in English (French is a plus).

 ➡️ What we can offer you 
 Cross-functional exposure: work closely with teams across Finance, Product, Tech and Growth, giving you a 360° view of how finance operates in a fintech at scale.

 A high-impact roadmap: participate in the transformation our current processes, tools and people into a best-in-class Finance function ready for our next stages of development.

 A playbook to build: help create and refine our finance transformation playbook, challenge existing processes and shape how we work.

 How we work: a data-driven, hands-on culture, with high autonomy and access to senior leaders when needed.

 Tools we use: our Finance stack includes SAP ERP Cloud, Coupa, Kyriba, Amelkis, and Anaplan.

 ➡️ Your future manager 
 Your manager will be Marie Pouzin , Head of Finance Transformation. Marie has led multiple successful finance transformation projects across very different environments (audit, large corporation, small start-up, scale-up). She combines a strategic vision with a hands-on approach, so you get both the guidance and the support you need to make a real impact.
  
 
 [DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along. 
 
 [HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here 
 
 [DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details. 
 
 🔒 Your security matters to us 
 Recruitment scams are on the rise. Qonto will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Qonto, please report it to

jobs.title: Strategic Project Manager Italy
jobs.description:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here ). 
  
 [OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve , Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.
  
 [OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.
  
 [AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work ( here ) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

  
 Join us as a Strategic Project Manager – Country Support (Italy) to help shape Qonto’s strategy in Italy and turn local priorities into action. Working with Fanny , our Strategy Director, and Italy’s country leadership, you’ll combine market insights, strategic planning and hands-on project leadership to support growth in the Italian market.
 You’ll join a Strategy talent pool where you can learn quickly, collaborate across teams and potentially grow into another function over time, such as Growth, Operations, Product or Tech.

 ➡️ What you’ll do 
 Understand the Italian market: Analyze market trends, customer needs, regulation and competition to anticipate their impact on Qonto and identify opportunities for growth.

 Shape the country strategy and plan: Work with Italy’s country leadership to identify opportunities and define and refresh the country strategy and priorities, connecting local opportunities with Qonto’s wider strategic plan. Track progress against the plan with the Finance Business Partner.

 Develop the strategy per segment: Analyze the market and customer base to define and refresh strategies for different customer segments and identify new business opportunities.

 Drive strategic projects from framing to execution: Assess the potential, scope, business case and strategic rationale of key initiatives supporting Italy’s priorities and OKRs. Lead or coordinate execution where needed, and hand projects over to country teams when ready. Projects will vary with country priorities and could include exploring a company-creation offering. Strong stakeholder management is essential.

 ➡️ What we’re looking for 
 Experience: You have around 4–5 years or more of relevant experience in strategic project management, consulting and/or a hands-on role in a startup or company. Consulting experience is useful but not required; experience in banking, payments or fintech is a plus, not a prerequisite.

 Analytical mindset: You enjoy exploring complex questions, researching markets and turning insights into clear, structured recommendations and action plans.

 Communication & synthesis: You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and can structure and present your ideas to a range of stakeholders.

 Project & stakeholder management: You can lead cross-functional projects, build alignment across teams and break down silos to move priorities forward.

 Ownership & pragmatism: You’re proactive, detail-oriented and hands-on. You take responsibility for your projects, from planning through execution, and follow through on delivery.

 Collaboration: You’re a team player who builds constructive relationships and energizes the people you work with.

 Curiosity & AI: You’re interested in financial services and eager to learn and experiment with AI in your work. Advanced AI expertise is not required.

 Languages: Fluency in Italian and English is required.

 ➡️ What we can offer you 
 Team & impact: Join the Strategy team and play a key role in shaping Qonto’s strategy and driving strategic projects in Italy.

 Exposure & collaboration: Work closely with country leadership, senior management and international teams across Growth, Product, Tech, Finance, Operations and Compliance.

 From strategy to execution: Stay close to the business, with opportunities to move from market analysis and strategic decisions to concrete local initiatives and outcomes.

 Learning & growth: Benefit from coaching and exposure to different areas of Qonto, with opportunities to grow within the Strategy team and potentially explore roles in other functions over time.

 AI & ways of working: Experiment with AI on projects and exchange practices with the team during strategy office hours.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Agent Experience ( Français/ Anglais)
jobs.description:
Product Manager – Agent Experience 
 Lieu : Paris de préférence, possibilité à Londres (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau)
 Équipe : Customer Care
 Langues : Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais
 Contrat : CDI
 Rattachement : Lead Product Manager
 À noter : ce poste est ouvert à Paris et à Londres, et nécessite un droit de travailler déjà acquis dans le pays où vous serez basé(e) (UE pour Paris, Royaume-Uni pour Londres). Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de parrainage de visa, mais nous étudions le parrainage poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour de futures opportunités. 
 
 Merci de soumettre votre CV en anglais. 
 
 À propos de Kaluza 
 Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les énergéticiens à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.
 Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En associant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours.
 Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des entreprises innovantes comme Volvo et Volkswagen.
 
 Ce que vous ferez 
 Piloter la roadmap : porter la stratégie de bout en bout de Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE) sur le marché européen, en cohérence avec les objectifs produit globaux et affinée par les besoins clients locaux et les comportements des agents. Vous suivrez les indicateurs opérationnels clés (AHT, FCR, CSAT, adoption de l’IA, onboarding) pour vous assurer que chaque évolution améliore l’expérience des agents et des clients.

 Concevoir les parcours et garantir la cohérence UX : être le garant de l’expérience agent sur l’ensemble de KAE. Vous travaillerez avec les équipes UX et métier pour appliquer des patterns communs, réduire la charge cognitive des agents et rester aligné avec le design system, y compris quand de nouvelles capacités d’automatisation et d’assistance par l’IA sont introduites.

 Mener les intégrations et l’onboarding client : piloter les intégrations techniques et produit avec des plateformes tierces, et superviser de bout en bout le déploiement de nouvelles instances KAE pour les nouveaux clients, de la phase de découverte jusqu’à la mise en production.

 Garantir l’accessibilité et la conformité : défendre les réglementations européennes d’accessibilité dès la conception, en traduisant les exigences réglementaires et spécifiques à chaque marché en besoins techniques concrets.

 Accompagner les clients et créer de la valeur : être l’expert de confiance des clients sur l’expérience agent, en défendant une configuration native de la plateforme plutôt que des développements sur mesure.

 Rester les mains dans le cambouis, de la livraison à l’accompagnement : vous impliquer sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie du développement produit (PDLC), des sessions de discovery avec les agents aux boucles de feedback, et produire les supports qui favorisent l’adoption côté clients.

 (À noter : des déplacements chez les clients, par exemple à Bruxelles, sont à prévoir, environ 1 à 3 par mois au début, puis 1 à 2 par trimestre.) 
 
 Ce que vous apporterez 
 Idéalement, vous avez :

 Une connaissance de l’accessibilité européenne et de l’intégration de plateformes : une bonne maîtrise des standards d’accessibilité européens, ainsi qu’une expérience avérée d’intégration de produits avec des plateformes tierces et des écosystèmes de fournisseurs complexes.

jobs.description:
Job title: Product Manager 

 Location: Paris — Hybrid - 3 days in office

 Team: Product Management - Customer Care Value Stream

 Reporting to: Head of Product
 
 This role is based in France and requires the successful candidate to be based in or willing to relocate to France. 
 At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship 
 
Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential for this position. Please submit your profile in English. 
 
 Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners.
 By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.
 With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.
 Where in the world of Kaluza will I be working 
 You will be specifically working with the team building out our contact centre solution and the Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE). Our Customer Care platform powers AI-driven, cost-efficient service operations for global energy retailers, enabling personalised customer experiences across contact centres, digital channels, and case management.
 This role is mission-critical to Kaluza’s vision. You will lead the product strategy, delivery, and client outcomes for Kaluza’s Customer Care solutions for ENGIE France , while contributing to the evolution of our Global Core capabilities.
 What will I be doing? 
 As the Customer Care Product Manager, you are accountable for the outcomes delivered by your product. You will ensure design and engineering teams have absolute clarity on priorities and scope to drive meaningful results for end users and commercial value.
 You will: 
 Lead Product Strategy: Own the Customer Care product strategy and roadmap for Kaluza clients in France, balancing Global Core reuse with specific French localisation requirements.

 Build High-Value Solutions: Develop our suite of tools for the Contact Centre Solution, including CCaaS (Contact Centre as a Service) and Case Management, to enable efficient, high-value conversations.

 Drive AI Innovation: Utilise the latest AI technology to automate and personalise the customer experience and champion agent productivity tools.

 Foster Client Partnerships: Act as the senior product counterpart to client stakeholders (such as ENGIE), leading workshops and translating their needs into scalable capabilities.

 Execute & Optimise: Lead cross-functional teams (engineering, design, data, and commercial) to ensure efficient delivery, removing blockers and resolving cross-team dependencies.

 Deliver Operational Excellence: Define and track key contact centre metrics such as AHT, FCR, CSAT, and NPS to ensure solutions deliver measurable cost-to-serve improvements.

 Is this the job for me? 
 You are the right person for us if you:
 Have significant product leadership experience in enterprise SaaS and have worked in agile product organisations.

 Possess deep knowledge of contact centre operations and agent workflows.

 Have experience working with French enterprise clients and a strong understanding of localisation requirements, including language and regulation.

 Are skilled at stakeholder management at the executive level , with the ability to manage trade-offs between speed and long-term value.

 Are data-oriented, with an adeptness for using operational metrics to assess product performance and drive continuous improvement.

 Have a background in energy retail or utilities (this will set you apart!).

 Are excited by AI-driven automation , including voice bots and agent assist technology.

 Kaluza Values 
 Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:
 Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together 
  
 We want the best people 
 We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.
 We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

Senior Professional Services Project Manager, Paris

An overview of this role

GitLab Senior Professional Services Project Managers manage complex projects from initiation through delivery and closure. In this role, you'll coordinate with cross-functional teams and our global customers to complete distinct projects on time and within budget. You'll use your experience managing information technology and software consulting projects and your knowledge of traditional and agile project management and software development methods. You'll also manage executive stakeholder communications, manage escalations, and help improve Professional Services project management practices.

What you’ll do
  • Manage large-scale commercial projects and executive stakeholder meetings and communications.

  • Summarize key customer projects monthly and provide a summary for quarterly business reviews.
  • Develop and manage delivery schedules, customer expectations, project scope, resources, status, risks, and issues for technical and consulting services.

  • Establish reliable, repeatable delivery processes, metrics, and operational procedures.
  • Set and achieve forecast goals by aligning customers, Technical Architects, project engineers, partner consultants, and delivery partners.

What you’ll bring
  • Experience managing complex information technology or software consulting projects for external customers from initiation through closure.

  • Ability to build effective relationships with customer leaders, communicate with internal and external stakeholders, and manage escalations.
  • Ability to identify and resolve project challenges, motivate advisory teams and contributors, and mediate conflicts.
  • Experience supporting timely revenue recognition and executing change orders when needed.
  • Knowledge of project management and technical delivery methods for software, including Project Management Institute methodologies, agile or Scrum, the software development lifecycle, and project management or agile tools such as GitLab.
  • Enterprise customer and Professional Services experience is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us 
 At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.
 
 The role 
 Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.
 
 You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.
 
 You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.
 
 Key responsibilities 
 Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.

 Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.

 Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.

 Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.

 Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.

 Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended.

 Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.

 Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client.

 Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse.

 Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.

 Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need.

 Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework.

 
 Your background 
 You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:
 A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there.

 Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with.

 Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working.

 A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role.

 A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant.

 Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Surveying & Mapping Drone
jobs.description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. 
 

 We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.
 

 Now we need someone to help decide what we build next. You’ll own the priorities for our data capture platform, from the aircraft to the sensors they carry. You’ll work side by side with customers in the field, Wingtra engineers and Wingtranauts across all business functions. Your job is to find the problems that matter most to our customers and turn good ideas into products people love. Inside Wingtra you’re the voice of the user. Outside you’re the voice of the product.

 Responsibilities 
 

 
 Know your customers. You spend time with survey and mapping teams in the field. You learn how they work, how they buy, what else they could use and what they still can’t do.

 
 Set the priorities. You weigh customer value, market opportunity, development effort, price and margin. Then you make a clear call on what comes next.

 
 Test ideas early. You try them with customers and engineers, learn fast and adjust.

 
 Shape the product development. You steer the capture platform: aircraft, sensors, workflows and data deliverables. You make the performance, reliability and usability trade-offs together with engineering.

 
 Take it to market. You launch with Product Marketing, Sales, Support and partners and explain why the product matters. After launch you stay close to field results and keep supporting the product through its lifecycle.

 
 Follow the outcomes. You track customer outcomes, usage and commercial results. You use what you learn to pick the next problem to solve with the team.

 Requirements 
 

 
 You have a taste for great products and a relentless drive to understand what makes users love them.

 
 You make things happen. You act like an owner and hold yourself accountable to outcomes not output. You care primarily about happy customers and a successful business.
You bring people with you. You listen closely, speak clearly and earn trust with customers and engineers, including when you disagree.

 
 You find a way forward. You are very comfortable with ambiguity. You work constructively with people and constraints, know when to push and when to adapt.

 
 You’ve spent 3+ years developing or deploying hardware products and their software workflows, with clear ownership of product, operational or commercial results.

 
 You have a technical background in engineering, geospatial or another technical field.

 
 You’re commercially fluent. You read a pricing model, channel margin or renewal term and see why the business cares.

 
 You’re fluent in English and happy to travel regularly to customers and partners in the US and Europe.

 Plus 
 

 
 You’ve founded a relevant business of your own, led surveying or drone operations, or built products for geospatial customers.

 
 You have hands-on experience with photogrammetry, LiDAR or bringing a commercial robotics product to market.

 If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Agentic Search
jobs.description:
The role 

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Agentic Search team, building the search and retrieval infrastructure that powers AI agents and LLM-based applications at scale.

This is a hands-on IC role with real ownership. You will take full end-to-end responsibility over a core product area, from defining strategy through shipping and iterating based on real usage data. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, design, and go-to-market, shaping how AI agents discover, retrieve, and act on web information in real time.

The product serves both a developer-facing PLG motion and a growing enterprise customer base, so you will need to be equally comfortable digging into API design and search quality as you are running customer discovery calls and informing competitive positioning. We are looking for someone who can operate as a senior strategic partner, not just an executor, and who has the potential to grow into a principal-level PM over time.

You’re welcome to work hybrid from Tel Aviv, Israel.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Own a core product area end-to-end: strategy, roadmap, execution, and iteration based on real usage signals and customer feedback.
  • Drive search quality and relevance improvements by working closely with engineering and research to define evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and release criteria.
  • Engage directly with enterprise customers and developer users to validate ideas, understand pain points, and shape product-market fit across both PLG and enterprise motions.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape in agentic search and AI-powered retrieval, identifying shifts, threats, and opportunities that should inform product decisions.
  • Collaborate with go-to-market teams (sales, solutions, growth) to ensure product positioning, ICP definitions, and enablement materials reflect product reality.
  • Contribute to product strategy as a senior voice on a small, high-impact team, challenging assumptions and bringing independent judgment to key decisions.
  • Lead product experiments and rapid iteration cycles, moving from hypothesis to prototype to production with clear success criteria.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in developer tools, API platforms, or search and retrieval infrastructure.
  • Track record of shipping products in fast-moving markets, working closely with engineering and design from concept through launch and iteration.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic workflows. Hands-on technical background is a strong plus.
  • Degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, with the ability to engage deeply with technical architecture and tradeoffs.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity: you can context-switch between strategic thinking and tactical execution without losing the thread.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment without formal authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: you can explain technical concepts clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders.

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  • Experience in search, information retrieval, NLP, or adjacent domains.
  • Background in API-first or developer-platform businesses with both PLG and enterprise motions.
  • Leadership experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments.
  • People management or mentoring experience (building the skills of other PMs).

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description:
About hyperexponential (hx)
 At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.
 Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.
 Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with close to zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.
 What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.
 What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.
 If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.
 
 About the Project Management team
 The Project Management team takes hx customers from signed contract to live in production. We work in cross-functional pods alongside delivery engineers and solution architects, and we own the customer relationship day to day: the plan, the budget, the risks and the conversations that go with them. We work with some of the most sophisticated insurers in the world, including Lloyd’s syndicates, Tier 1 carriers, reinsurers and MGAs. We are moving to a shared, AI-first way of working, where one set of skills is used and improved by the whole team, and we are looking for people who want to help build it.
 
 What you’ll be doing
 Run a customer project from kick-off to go-live, keeping budget, timeline and project hygiene on track.

 Be the day-to-day contact for your customer, and tell them early when something is slipping.

 Work with delivery engineers and solution architects in your pod to turn what the customer needs into a plan the team can deliver.

 Use our shared delivery skills and AI tools to cut manual project admin, and flag where they fall short.

 Learn from your delivery lead and bring proposed answers, not just questions.

 Help us improve how we run projects as you learn what works.

 
 What you’ll need to have done
 Delivered something to a deadline with other people depending on you (work, university or a side project), and be able to say exactly what you did.

 Used AI in your work or studies day to day, and be able to explain what it produced and how you checked it.

 Taken feedback and changed how you work, with an example.

 Gone beyond the surface of a problem to find out what was really going on.

 
 You’re unlikely to thrive here if
 You’d prefer a long runway of shadowing before taking on real responsibility. You’ll own a customer project early, with coaching alongside you.

 You’re uncomfortable being the person customers turn to when something goes wrong or when there is hard news to deliver.

 You wait for direction rather than forming a view and bringing it to the team.

 If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.
 
 Compensation
 At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.
 Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.
 
 Benefits
 £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

 Company pension scheme via Penfold .

 Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life .

 Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno .

 Private healthcare insurance through AXA .

 Income protection and Life Insurance.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our growing Product Marketing team and help shape how Addepar goes to market across EMEA, LATAM and APAC. You will become a trusted expert on the buyers, segments, market dynamics, competitive landscapes and regional nuances that influence how we position Addepar and engage prospects and clients in each market.

You’ll work closely with regional Sales, Relationship Management and Performance Marketing teams, along with Product and other go-to-market partners, to translate market insight into differentiated positioning, campaigns, enablement and launch strategies. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role for a product marketer who can connect Addepar’s global platform narrative to the distinct needs, use cases and product availability of each region.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and execute product marketing strategies for clients and prospects across EMEA, LATAM and APAC, aligned with company and platform priorities.
  • Build deep market expertise by understanding regional buyers, buying committees, client needs, competitive dynamics and cultural nuances.
  • Partner closely with regional Sales, Relationship Management and Performance Marketing teams to identify priorities and develop coordinated go-to-market programs.
  • Define regional positioning and messaging that connects Addepar’s global value proposition to the needs of prospective buyers and existing clients.
  • Adapt broader product launches for regional audiences and product availability, while owning end-to-end launches for region-specific capabilities.
  • Develop campaigns that generate awareness and demand among prospects while supporting engagement, adoption and expansion among clients.
  • Create scalable content and enablement, monitor program performance and use market and stakeholder feedback to continually strengthen our approach.

Who You Are

  • 5–8 years of product marketing or related go-to-market experience. Experience with B2B SaaS, financial services, fintech, wealth management or investment management is preferred.
  • Full-stack product marketer with experience across market research, positioning, messaging, launches, campaigns, enablement and content.
  • Experience adapting go-to-market strategies for different markets, audiences or customer needs; direct experience in every region is not required.
  • Excellent storyteller, writer and communicator who can translate sophisticated capabilities into clear customer value.
  • Strong cross-functional partner who can build trusted relationships with regional Sales, Marketing, Relationship Management and Product teams.
  • Globally minded and curious, with the judgment to balance a consistent global narrative with meaningful regional differences.
  • Comfortable working independently across multiple priorities, collaborating across time zones and traveling internationally as needed.

Our Values 

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Us
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.
 We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

 We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

 We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
 The Role 
 We’re looking for a senior Product Manager to build user-facing products that impact hundreds of thousands of legal professionals. You’ll have the opportunity to join and lead one of the product teams shaping the core of the Legora platform, working across surfaces like our drafting products, tabular review, task management, and research and regulatory products.
 Wherever you land, the mandate is the same: build 0-to-1 products that help revolutionize a legacy profession. You’ll do it inside an AI-native company growing at hyper speed, with the autonomy to take ideas from a blank canvas to products that thousands of lawyers rely on every day. This is a rare chance to define entirely new categories of legal software, not iterate on the old ones.

 What You'll Do 
 Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for one of our core user-facing product areas, such as drafting, tabular review, task management, or research and regulatory products.

 Build 0-to-1 products and features from the ground up, taking ideas from concept to launch and iterating quickly based on real user feedback.

 Partner closely with design and engineering to ship polished, AI-native experiences with a strong bar for craft.

 Deeply understand how legal professionals work, and translate their needs into intuitive, opinionated product decisions.

 Use AI as a core building block, shaping how legal professionals work with and trust AI in their day-to-day.

 Run experiments, instrument the right metrics, and turn data and qualitative insight into a prioritized roadmap.

 Move fast in a high-growth environment, balancing speed with quality and a relentless focus on user impact.

 
 What You Bring 
 An experienced, senior Product Manager with a strong background building user-facing products at high-growth B2B SaaS companies.

 A track record of building 0-to-1 products that have had a major impact on users.

 Hands-on experience building AI-native products, where AI is a central part of the experience.

 Strong product judgment and the ability to balance qualitative insight with quantitative rigor.

 Excellent collaboration skills, with a history of partnering tightly with design, engineering, and other functions to ship products.

 A genuine interest in revolutionizing a legacy profession and making complex software feel simple, fast, and enjoyable.

 High standards, low ego, and a bias toward ownership and outcomes.

 Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Compliance & Recording
jobs.description:
About Us 
 1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.
 
Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.
 
Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity.
 
About the Team 
 The Compliance & Recording team owns 1GLOBAL's products for regulated enterprises. We capture mobile voice, SMS and data at network level, with no app on the device, and deliver it to wherever our customers need it: their own on-site recorders and archives, or our Cloud Compliance service built on Verint Financial Compliance. On top of the recordings we offer Communications Analytics, which brings AI transcription, summaries and risk insights to compliance teams.
 Our customers include 8 of the world's 10 largest banks. They rely on us for a complete, auditable record of every regulated call and message, so reliability and precision are at the heart of everything the team builds. We work closely with engineering, network, security, service delivery and commercial teams.
 We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own how recorded communications are captured, delivered and analysed. This is an API-first, backend role: there is little UI at its core, because for our customers the integration is the product.
 
About the Role 
 You will lead product strategy and delivery for Compliance & Recording, from the APIs and delivery channels that move recorded data into customer environments to the AI capabilities we build on top of it. 
 Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for Compliance & Recording, covering customer-managed (on-site) recording, Cloud Compliance and the integrations that connect them to customer systems.
 Define and evolve how recorded voice, SMS and data reach customers through APIs, SFTP, SMTP and S3 bucket pushes, choosing the right mechanism for each use case.
 Write precise technical requirements: API contracts, payload and metadata schemas, delivery guarantees, retry and failure handling, security controls and acceptance criteria.
 Lead large projects for our biggest compliance customers, onboarding their engineering and compliance teams with proper documentation, from scoping through rollout.
 Define and track success metrics such as delivery success rate, latency, capture completeness and time to integrate, and keep the roadmap aligned with regulatory change and the competitive landscape.
 Requirements 
 About You 
 Must Have 
 6+ years in product management, with end-to-end ownership of API-first, backend or platform products where there is little or no UI.
 Deep, hands-on knowledge of APIs: REST design, authentication, versioning, webhooks, pagination, error handling and idempotency. You read OpenAPI specs, test endpoints yourself and hold your own in design discussions with engineers.
 Solid understanding of file and message-based integrations such as SFTP, SMTP and object storage (for example AWS S3), including batch versus near real-time delivery, encryption and access control.
 A track record of leading large, cross-functional projects for enterprise customers with demanding technical, security and reliability requirements.
 Clear, precise writing: requirements, acceptance criteria and edge cases that engineering teams can build from without guesswork.
 A genuine interest in compliance products and enterprise integrations. You want to understand how regulated firms capture, retain and supervise communications, and why every record matters.
 Confident communication with engineers, customer technical teams, compliance officers and executives, in fluent written and spoken English.
 
Nice to Have 
 Telecom experience, for example mobile voice and SMS, MVNO platforms, SIP, call recording or CDRs.
 Compliance or regtech experience, such as communications recording, archiving or surveillance.
 Experience shipping AI features in production, such as speech-to-text, LLM evaluation or human-in-the-loop review.

 Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepren

jobs.title: Product Manager - Internal Tools and AI
jobs.description:
Our mission

 We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

 In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

 We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

 Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

 How you'll help us achieve it

 Every promise our products make to a user or merchant is kept by an internal team somewhere in the company. When those teams can organise their work, adapt quickly and stay focused, Wave moves fast; when they can't, the company slows down and customers feel it. When we were smaller, organizing work didn't take much more than a quick spreadsheet but that breaks at scale.

 Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and the Gambia. We work with millions of users every month, employ thousands of people, and are growing rapidly. Similar processes now run in a dozen countries, but each team has built its own version, either because they don't know a better one exists or because setting it up well is harder than it should be.

 AI has made this both better and worse: anyone can now build a workflow in an hour, but many aren't secure, won't scale, cost too much, or automate a process that should have been simplified first. Your job is to think from first principles about how work at Wave should run, give people a consistent and safe way to improve their own workflows, and make the common ones easy to adopt.

 We're looking for a product manager who gets a kick out of figuring out how work should actually flow, and who doesn't much care whether the answer is a tool we build, a workflow in something we already pay for, or no tool at all. Someone who enjoys getting into the weeds with operations teams and who turns what they learn there into playbooks and building blocks every team can use.

 In this role, you'll...

 
 
 
 Own how Wave's general work tools get used. You're accountable for tools like Slack, Monday, and AI serving teams well. You work with the People team and other stakeholders to make sure they're set up so that organizing work or finding an answer is easy from day one. You help us make the right calls on major vendor decisions using what you've seen first-hand from users.

 Help operations teams use AI efficiently and safely. You find the use cases where it truly saves teams time and turn those into shared skills, bots, and templates others can pick up in minutes. You build with these tools every day and teach teams to build in a secure and affordable way.

 Care about the person, but solve for the company. There are far more problems than you can take on, so you pick the ones that help the most teams. You turn each solution into a playbook, template, or building block, and work through champions in every team to carry it forward.

 Make sure each problem gets solved the right way. You're the expert on how people organize work in general, but behind every workflow sits domain context, constraints, and sometimes a product tool that already fits. You work with the leaders and PMs in that domain to decide whether a process should be simplified, automated, or shouldn't exist at all.

 Build the team this work needs, starting with you. In your first few months you'll spend much of your time in-country with our operations teams as an IC, setting up workflows yourself with Slack and Monday.com, creating Claude skills and writing the first playbooks. As you learn more about what the company needs you can help us form a team around you.

 

 
 Key Details 

 
 This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA, Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso

 Wave is a distributed team, and we fund up to three in-person get-togethers a year, in line with Wave's travel policy.

 The opportunity 
 Own growth in viral, KOL- and creator-referred new transacting users (NTUs). Set aggressive NTU targets backed by a credible growth model, then beat them. Build and scale sharing, referral, and creator systems that drive 10x, then 50x growth while hitting payback targets.

 Build sharing people find useful. Create natural reasons to pass on product value, and referral programs with modeled payback incentives, and without relying on aggressive incentives to hit targets. Make both work for the sender, recipient, and business.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que de vrais utilisateurs s’appuient sur ce que vous livrez.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Product Engineer.

 

Activités et responsabilités

À chaque projet, l’AI Product Manager pilote le produit avec le client : ce qui se construit en premier, et la vérification que les utilisateurs s’en servent, se décident à deux.

  4. Des besoins d’utilisateurs transformés en une première version, puis améliorée à partir de leurs retours.

  5. Le monitoring, les incidents et l’adoption font, pour vous, partie du métier.

  6. Une aisance à expliquer vos choix techniques à des personnes non techniques.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Une expérience de construction d’agents ou d’assistants au-dessus d’un LLM : appel d’outils, orchestration.

  • Une expérience de conception de parcours avec validation humaine (human-in-the-loop) ou d’interfaces d’IA.

  • Une expérience d’intégration à des logiciels métier, comme un ERP ou un CRM.

  • Une expérience au contact des clients.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Entre le produit, l’interface et le modèle, le Product Engineer occupe le point où l’IA rencontre ses utilisateurs. Leurs réactions s’observent directement, et chaque version livrée tient compte de ce que les usages ont révélé.

 Wir haben in den letzten Jahren gezeigt, dass wir echte Kundenprobleme lösen können. Jetzt geht es darum, aus bewährten Lösungen wiederholbare Produkte zu machen, die sich skalierbar verkaufen und liefern lassen. Genau dafür suchen wir Dich!

 Validierte Lösungen konsequent in wiederholbare, standardisierte Angebote überführen
 Zielkunden, Pain, Business Value und Value Proposition schärfen
 Klaren Standardumfang und klare Produktgrenzen definieren – inklusive dessen, was bewusst nicht dazugehört

 Kundenfeedback pragmatisch in Produktentscheidungen übersetzen
 Product Marketing die fachliche Grundlage für Positionierung, Messaging und Content geben
 Sales und Presales befähigen, das Produkt ohne permanente Product-Unterstützung zu erklären und zu verkaufen
 Delivery befähigen, Einführung und Betrieb mit kalkulierbarem Aufwand umzusetzen
 Lifecycle, Weiterentwicklung und Priorisierung verantworten, für neu produktisierte ebenso wie für bestehende Produkte, deren Stärken und Standards es zu sichern gilt
 Was Du mitbringst
 5+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Product Management im komplexen B2B- bzw. Enterprise-Software-Umfeld
 Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, aus individuellen Kundenanforderungen, Piloten oder Prototypen ein standardisiertes, wiederholbares Produkt zu machen
 Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis für komplexe Software-, Daten- und AI-Produkte: Du arbeitest mit Engineering auf Augenhöhe und verbindest Business, Kunde, Produkt und Technologie – ohne selbst Engineer sein zu müssen
 Pragmatische Arbeitsweise mit starkem 80/20-Schnitt und schneller Entscheidungsfähigkeit auch bei unvollständigen Informationen, getragen von fundierter methodischer Product-Erfahrung
 Hohe Ownership: Risiken früh erkennen und mit einer klaren Empfehlung kommen statt mit der Bitte um mehr Zeit oder Ressourcen
 Klarer Fokus auf Business Value und Ergebnisse statt auf Prozesse, mit dem Talent, Komplexität zu reduzieren
 Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Industriekunden oder Enterprise-Lösungen wie Manufacturing, PLM, ERP, SCM oder Data
 Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine vor Ort
 Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

 Damit Du einschätzen kannst, ob die Rolle zu Dir passt: Wir suchen bewusst nicht
 einen klassischen Product Owner mit Schwerpunkt Backlog und Tickets,
 einen reinen Projektmanager,

 einen technischen Product Manager, der primär in Features und Architektur denkt.
 Benefits:

 Kurze Wege: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Engineering, Sales und Delivery
 Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeiten, flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub
 Modernes Umfeld: Büro im Münchner Werksviertel (House of Communication), moderne Ausstattung und internationale, diverse Teams

In July, we launched in the US. 
 We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.
 About the role 
Hilo is looking for an experienced Human Factors Project Manager to own all of our human factors and usability work. Right now that work is split across Product, Design, Clinical Operations, QARA and outside agencies, and no single person is accountable for it. You'll be that person. You'll coordinate the specialists, keep work moving between teams and make sure every deliverable meets the quality and regulatory standard. That frees our domain teams to get back to their own work.
 What you'll own 
 Usability studies: You'll own the study calendar, protocols and relationships with external labs such as Sage Research.  Packaging: You'll own packaging briefs from start to finish and coordinate agencies (ARD, Superhuit, Carac Design) and freelance packaging designers. You'll keep the work aligned with regulatory, cost and manufacturing constraints.

 Roadmap and reporting: You'll keep a single human factors roadmap and manage dependencies, resourcing and budgets across teams. Each month you'll report confidence levels and raise any risks to leadership.
 
 This is a part time contractor role of up to three days per week, with a total fee of CHF 17,500 for the initial engagement. We would like to start as soon as possible, with a review after three months. 
 Requirements 
 What you'll bring 
 Human factors or usability engineering experience in medical devices, ideally with wearables or connected health

 Hands-on knowledge of IEC 62366 usability engineering, use-related risk documentation (e.g. UFMEAs) and IFU development
 Experience managing agencies, labs and freelancers
 Clear, confident communication, with a track record of connecting Product, Clinical and Quality/Regulatory teams
 
 First priorities 
 Audit of our current processes and human factors function
 Set up the usability study calendar
 Get a decision on the content split for the QSG "5-minute sheet" redesign
 
 Nice to have: FDA submission experience, a UX research background, and familiarity with InDesign/Figma localisation workflows

 Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with quality. You treat feedback as a chance to learn, and you're deep in customer and partner feedback — translating it to action quickly.

 KI und Automatisierung wirksam machen. Du erkennst wiederkehrende Fehlerbilder, machst Kunden- und Geschäftsauswirkungen greifbar und bringst fundierte Verbesserungen in die Priorisierung mit Product und Engineering ein. Du hältst Entscheidungen nach und prüfst die Wirkung umgesetzter Änderungen. So werden Einzelfälle zu Erkenntnissen, die über den Support hinaus etwas verändern.

Ein Supportmodell, das mit dem Unternehmen wachsen kann. L1 löst mehr geeignete Fälle selbst, L2 bringt komplexe Probleme verlässlich zum Abschluss, und KI und Automatisierung entlasten die Teams nachweislich. Wiederkehrende Fehler und ihre Auswirkungen werden sichtbar und beeinflussen Produktentscheidungen. Dafür verbindest du die Verantwortung für den Aufbau mit eigener technischer Arbeit und direktem Kundenkontakt.

Du kannst mit Engineers tief in Ursachen einsteigen und aus unscharfen Problemen belastbare Diagnosen machen.

Du kannst selbst prototypisch arbeiten, mit Engineering produktionsfähige Lösungen vorantreiben und beurteilen, wo Automatisierung hilft und wo menschliches Urteil nötig bleibt.

jobs.title: Senior Strategy & Project Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Als Senior Strategy & Project Manager im Management Office verantwortest du eigenständig strategische Projekte mit hohem Business Impact und unterstützt primär unsere Geschäftsführung als analytischer Sparringspartner bei zentralen unternehmerischen Fragestellungen. Du treibst High-Impact-Initiativen voran, behältst die relevanten KPIs im Blick und trägst so unmittelbar zur erfolgreichen Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung von LIQID bei.
 Diese Position bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, tiefgehende Einblicke in das Management und die verschiedensten Bereiche eines der innovativsten Scale-Ups im Bereich Financial Services zu gewinnen und direkten Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung von LIQID zu nehmen.
 Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. Aufgrund der Nähe zum Senior Management ist eine hohe Präsenz im Berliner Büro Voraussetzung.
 
 Was machst du dabei konkret? 
 Strategische Projekte: Du leitest High-Impact-Initiativen end-to-end, treibst deren Umsetzung voran und bist dabei inhaltlich tief in den Themen involviert, um die bestmöglichen Lösungen zu erarbeiten.

 Datenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung: Du hast einen Blick auf alle relevanten KPIs, leitest fundierte Empfehlungen ab und trägst dazu bei, datengetriebene Entscheidungen zu treffen. Für unsere Geschäftsführung bist du dabei ein Key Sparrings Partner.

 Business Impact & strategische Analysen: Du erstellst Entscheidungsgrundlagen, Business Cases und Analysen zu zentralen strategischen Fragestellungen und stellst sicher, dass strategische Prioritäten effizient umgesetzt werden.

 Business Transformation: Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale in Prozessen und Strukturen innerhalb eines oder über Teams hinweg und treibst die kontinuierliche organisatorische Weiterentwicklung.

 Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit den Executive und Leadership Teams sowie den Fachbereichen zusammen, koordinierst über Teamgrenzen hinweg und sorgst für eine reibungslose Umsetzung.

 Stakeholder Management : Du bist eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unserem CEO, der Geschäftsführung und externen Stakeholdern. Du pflegst du den Kontakt zu Partnern und Investoren, bereitest Updates und Unterlagen vor und unterstützt den CEO und die Geschäftsführung bei strategischen Diskussionen.

 
 Das bringst du mit: 
 Akademischer Background: Ein exzellenter Abschluss einer Top-Tier Business School, Wirtschafts- oder Technischen Universität mit Schwerpunkt auf Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Management oder angrenzenden Bereichen.

 Berufserfahrung: mind. 5 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Bereich Strategieberatung, Investment Banking, Private Equity oder Venture Capital bzw. in einer vergleichbaren strategischen Rolle (idealerweise mit Bezug zu Financial Services oder Tech Scale-Ups).

 Projektmanagement: Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung und Umsetzung komplexer Projekte mit mehreren Stakeholdern.

 Analytische & strategische Fähigkeiten: Eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Zahlen und ein hohes Maß an Detailorientierung.

 Kommunikationsstärke: Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten in schriftlicher und mündlicher Kommunikation auf deutschsprachigem Muttersprachniveau sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

 Hands-on-Mentalität: Eigeninitiative, Durchsetzungsvermögen und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen Umfeld pragmatische Lösungen zu finden.

 Das bieten wir dir: 
 Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten.

 Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten.

 Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen.

 Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display.

 Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern.

 So geht es für dich weiter

jobs.title: Product Manager - AI Neobank App
jobs.description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

 Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

 Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

 Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

 Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

 Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

 Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

  
 What We're Looking For 
 Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

 Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

 Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

 Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

 Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

 High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

  
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

 Can make decisions with incomplete information.

 Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

 Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

 Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

  
 This Role Is Not For 
 People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

 PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

 Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

 People who launch features and then stop caring.

 PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

  
 Location 
 This role is based in United Kingdom . This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
