jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - SAP BW Modernization (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Notre équipe Decathlon Digital recherche un·e Chef·fe de Projet Senior - Modernisation SAP BW (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille. Au cœur de la transformation technologique de notre Value Chain, notre équipe est responsable de la donnée d'entreprise. 

Notre grand défi est la modernisation de notre environnement de données et analytique, allant d'un SAP BW On-Premise vers le Cloud - PCE ("Lift and Shift" SAP BW vers le Cloud), jusqu'à l'implémentation et la migration progressive vers SAP Business Data Cloud et SAP Datasphere. Rejoindre notre équipe, c'est évoluer dans un environnement agile, où chaque donnée compte pour rendre le sport accessible au plus grand nombre.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION 

En tant que pilier technique et méthodologique, tu seras responsable de la stratégie de modernisation de notre écosystème de données. Tes missions principales incluent:

  • Pilotage du "Lift and Shift" SAP BW: Tu diriges la phase de migration initiale de notre environnement SAP BW actuel vers le Cloud (Private Cloud Edition).
  • Stratégie de Migration Progressive: Tu orchestres l'implémentation et la bascule graduelle vers notre nouvelle architecture cible sur SAP BDC (Business Data Cloud) et SAP Datasphere.
  • Écosystème et Continuité: Tu sécurises les flux de données et garantis une continuité totale du reporting et de l'analytique sans aucune régression pour les utilisateurs métiers.
  • Animation transverse: Tu coordonnes les équipes techniques et produits, animes la gouvernance du projet, gères les répétitions de bascule et pilotes l'accompagnement au changement.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Une expertise confirmée en architecture SAP BW et en gestion de projet SAP, avec une expérience concrète sur SAP Datasphere (ou implémentations de projets SAP/Data similaires).
  • Une expérience solide en gestion de projets de migration de données complexes.
  • Une capacité à naviguer dans des modèles de données complexes tout en gardant une vision stratégique et technique claire.
  • Ta rigueur analytique, ta résistance au stress lors des phases de cutover et ton aisance pour animer des instances de gouvernance internationales.

STACK TECHNIQUE SAP BW, HANA, SAP BDC, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, Databricks.

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows);
  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale);
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.);
  • Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE 

Chez DECATHLON, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es. Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT
jobs.description:
The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT owns the DeepHealth Acute Care CT Suite end to end, with primary accountability for what to build and shared accountability for getting it shipped. DeepHealth is building the Acute Care CT Suite from the ground up to cover detection, care coordination, and reporting for emergency CT, starting with head CT and expanding to chest and abdomen, where minutes saved in stroke, bleeds, and trauma directly affect patient outcomes. The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT shapes the suite from day one: owning the roadmap, translating clinical needs into ML and product work, and driving cross-functional delivery on a subset of the suite from data through customer activation. The role does not write code or own technical software design.
 
 Essential Duties and Responsibilities
 
 Product Strategy and Roadmap
 Own the Acute Care CT Suite roadmap and define what to build, defer, or stop based on evidence.

 Define suite scope across pathology detection modules, software capabilities such as alerting and care coordination, and comprehensive draft reporting.

 Work with emergency radiologists and neuro/stroke teams to distinguish stated requests from real clinical needs, including time-to-treatment, triage, missed findings, and care coordination.

 Translate clinical problems into ML work and set model metrics that reflect clinical value, including sensitivity versus false-positive burden.

 Track the acute care market (including Aidoc, Viz.ai , RapidAI, Nicolab, and peers) and position products with Sales and Marketing.

 Delivery and Cross-Functional Execution

 Own delivery end to end on a subset of the Suite, from data to customer activation, including planning, coordination across data, ML, software, QARA, and Support, tracking, and escalation.

 Run squads for new devices (typically 3 to 9 months), such as ASPECTS detection.

 Coordinate with QARA on the regulatory impact of each release, including EU MDR and FDA 510(k).

 Cut scope or move dates when needed, and escalate further as required.

 Partner with engineering and technical leads without writing code or carrying technical software design.
 

 PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.
 
 
 Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience
 Bachelor's degree in a technical, scientific, clinical, business, or related field, or equivalent experience (required).

 8+ years in product or delivery for medical devices or medical imaging software, with products shipped end to end (required).

 Knowledge of radiology and emergency department workflows (required).

 Knowledge of machine learning in Clinical AI (required).

 Experience running cross-functional delivery across data, ML, software, and QA/RA to fixed dates (required).

 Fluent English (required).

 Hands-on use of AI tools (Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar) in current work (required).

 Preferred: French language skills.

 Preferred: Acute care, stroke, or emergency imaging background.

 Preferred: Experience with SaMD and regulated environments (EU MDR, FDA 510(k)).

 Quality Standards

 Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

 Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.

 Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

 Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

 Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.

 Practices universal safety precautions.

 Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.

 Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.

 Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

 Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

 
 Travel
 This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%.

jobs.description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot,   based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture   puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75  (more about our culture here ).

 Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.
 AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work ( here )  - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Working with Fanny , our Strategy Director, and senior stakeholders across Qonto, you’ll assess opportunities, inform key decisions and lead cross-functional projects through to execution.

 Shape strategic planning and priorities: Contribute to Qonto’s strategic planning process, help define company-wide priorities and turn them into company OKRs and key projects. Track progress and help assess when priorities need to evolve. Work with Corporate Development to articulate Qonto’s vision and strategy for internal and external audiences.

 Build market and strategic insights: Analyze market trends, customer needs and Qonto’s competitive position to assess opportunities, develop clear and actionable recommendations and support decision-making, particularly for Product, Growth, Ops and Corporate Development.

 Drive strategic projects from framing to execution: Lead cross-functional initiatives or bring strategic input to unblock a team’s project across new products and adjacencies, growth acceleration and operational efficiency.

 ➡️ What we’re looking for 
 Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm and/or as a strategic project manager in a startup or company. Experience in banking or financial services is a plus, not a requirement; curiosity about the sector is important.

 Strategic thinking & analysis: You enjoy exploring complex questions, combining market and customer insights with quantitative and financial analysis to build structured, actionable recommendations.

 Communication & synthesis: You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and can structure and present insights to a range of audiences, including senior stakeholders.

 Project & stakeholder management: You can lead cross-functional projects with autonomy, bring people together around shared goals and break down silos to move work forward.

 Ownership & pragmatism: You’re proactive, detail-oriented and hands-on. You take responsibility for moving from an idea or recommendation to concrete action and follow through on delivery.

 Curiosity & AI: You’re eager to learn, explore new opportunities and experiment with AI in your work. Advanced AI expertise is not required.

 Languages: Fluent English is required; French or another European language is a plus.

 From strategy to execution: Stay close to the business and see your recommendations move beyond the slide deck into real projects and outcomes.

 Learning & growth: Benefit from coaching and exposure to different areas of Qonto, with opportunities to grow within the Strategy team and potentially explore roles in other functions over time.

 AI & ways of working: Experiment with AI on projects and exchange practices with the team during strategy office hours.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager - Enterprise
jobs.description:
The Role
 About H 
 H exists to push the boundaries of superintelligence with agentic AI. By automating complex, multi-step tasks typically performed by humans, AI agents will help unlock full human potential.
 H is hiring the world’s best AI talent, seeking those who are dedicated as much to building safely and responsibly as to advancing disruptive agentic capabilities. We promote a mindset of openness, learning, and collaboration, where everyone has something to contribute.
 Your role 
 At H, Product Marketing is the expert on our customers and our market. It decides how H is positioned and differentiated, and makes our value obvious.
 H Company is seeking a Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise to help our sales teams win and grow our largest customers. You will own the messaging, enablement and proof that make our enterprise offer easy to understand, easy to trust and easy to buy, in long sales cycles with engineers, business leaders and the C-suite around the table.
 This role is ideal for a hands-on product marketer who loves being close to the field and excels at turning complex technology into stories that convert. You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Engineers, Product and Marketing to position H as the reference for AI agents in the enterprise.
 What you will own 
 Voice of the customer 
 Capture field feedback (objections, lost deals) and competitive insights to keep our messaging grounded in what AI transformation leaders actually care about

 Share insights with Product Marketing, Sales and Product to inform positioning and roadmap decisions

 Positioning and messaging 
 Adapt our product messaging for each audience (C-level, technical leaders, operational managers), translating technical features into compelling, value-based stories

 Build and maintain playbooks for our priority industries, use cases and personas

 Provide key messages and content used in acquisition campaigns

 Sales enablement 
 Build and maintain the sales kit (pitch deck, one-pagers, FAQ, battlecards, objection handling) for a sales team navigating long enterprise cycles

 Stay close to deals: listen to calls, join key meetings and track which materials work and which don’t

 Prepare Sales for model releases and product launches with materials and training

 Proof and credibility 
 Produce customer case studies, success stories and testimonials with our Forward Deployed Engineers and customers, to equip Sales and Marketing

 Run our analyst program: track and plan our participation, build and maintain a reusable answer library, and turn analyst recognition into GTM assets (one-pagers, website proof points, PR)

 About you 
 An autonomous doer, comfortable close to the field, who knows how to move forward from an existing framework and make technical topics simple.
 Experience: 3 to 5 years in product marketing, sales enablement or solutions marketing, ideally in B2B tech with complex sales cycles and enterprise sales teams

 Environment: experience in fast-moving, international settings, ideally a startup, a scale-up or the AI sector

 Storytelling: you understand technical products and translate them into business value, with polished materials and sharp copy

 Cross-functional: you get things done with Sales, Product and RevOps

 AI-driven productivity: you use AI tools to produce faster without sacrificing quality

 Curiosity: you love new technologies

 Languages: fluent in English and French, written and spoken

 Location 
 Paris or London.

 This role is hybrid, and you are expected to be in the office 3 days a week on average.

 Please expect some travel between offices on a reasonable cadence (e.g., every 4-6 weeks).

 What We Offer 
 Join the exciting journey of shaping the future of AI, and be part of the early days of one of the hottest AI startups

 Collaborate with a fun, dynamic and multicultural team, working alongside world-class AI talent in a highly collaborative environment

 Enjoy a competitive salary

 Unlock opportunities for professional growth, continuous learning, and career development

 If you want to change the status quo in AI, join us.

About Horizon Trading Solutions 

Horizon Trading Solutions is an independent global technology company focused on electronic trading, supporting agency and principal business goals across equities and derivatives. For over 20 years, we have equipped leading capital market participants with algorithmic trading technology and direct connectivity to more than 80 exchanges worldwide.

Product Delivery

  • Own and prioritize the backlog
  • Work closely with Engineering teams to drive implementation

Internal Enablement

Profile

  • Experience in Product Ownership, Product Management or Business Analysis

jobs.title: Technology Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About the role 
 We are looking for a Technology Marketing Manager to turn Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and long-term vision into compelling stories for engineers and executives.
 This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, marketing, and go-to-market .
 You will develop a deep understanding of Neural Concept’s technology and work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to create and continuously improve how our platform is explained to enterprise audiences.
 Your work will directly shape how global enterprises perceive Neural Concept: not as a point solution, but as an intelligence layer that brings AI into engineering workflows , helping Global 2000 engineering leaders design better products faster.
 This is a high-impact role with significant autonomy, offering the opportunity to take ownership of complex topics, shape Neural Concept’s technical and market narrative, and potentially grow into leading a product marketing team as the company scales.
 
 What you will do 
 Technology & Product Narrative 
 Develop a deep, hands-on understanding of Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and roadmap.

 Act as a primary internal reference for market-facing technology and product narratives.

 Turn complex technical concepts into clear explanations, examples, and value stories for engineering and executive audiences.

 Work closely with leadership and Product to ensure alignment between vision, roadmap, and market messaging.

 Messaging & Positioning Framework 
 Structure and maintain the core messaging framework in collaboration with leadership and Sales Enablement.

 Define how Neural Concept’s technology is positioned across personas, industries, and use cases.

 Ensure consistency and clarity across all market-facing materials (website, flagship assets, campaigns).

 Clearly articulate technical differentiation and competitive positioning in a factual, grounded way.

 Content Strategy & Creation 
 Own and produce technology- and product-driven content across flagship assets (hero blogs, whitepapers, product pages, decks).

 Translate ongoing technical innovation into concrete, high-quality content that can be used externally by customers, partners, and sales teams.

 Partner with the Design team to shape and produce high-quality product and technology content, including diagrams, visual explanations, demos and videos.

 Go-to-Market Foundations (in collaboration) 
 Produce use-case content, value stories, and messaging inputs that Sales Enablement and Marketing actively use in customer conversations and campaigns.

 Collaborate with Sales Enablement to ensure product and technology narratives are translated into clear, consistent sales messaging.

 Support entry into new industries or use cases by clarifying positioning and value stories, without owning sales strategy or execution.

 Cross-functional Collaboration 
 Partner closely with Product, Applied Engineering, Sales Enablement, Marketing, and Leadership.

 Act as a bridge between technical teams and market-facing functions.

 Contribute to strategic discussions on positioning, category evolution, and long-term narrative.

 
 Who you are 
 Experience & Skills 
 5+ years of experience in technology marketing, technical product marketing, or market-facing technical roles within B2B or deep-tech companies.

 You combine technical depth with a strong sense for marketing and storytelling, whether you built it in a marketing role or on the technical side.

 Demonstrated ability to deeply understand complex technology platforms and systems, and reason about how they create value in real-world engineering workflows.

 Engineering background (e.g., mechanical, aerospace, or computational engineering) or hands-on familiarity with CAD, CAE, or simulation tools is a strong plus.

 Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to translate technical capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs into clear market positioning.

 Proven ability to structure and maintain coherent messaging and positioning frameworks grounded in technical reality.

 Track record of producing substantial, high-quality marketing content for complex technical products.

 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt the message to very different audiences, from engineers and technical experts to executives, decision-makers, and non-technical stakeholders.

 Comfortable engaging in technical discussions and asking the right questions to build accurate, credible market narratives.

 Fluent in English, written and spoken.
 

 Ways of working 
 Able to drive complex topics from exploration to execution.

 Able to operate with a high degree of autonomy while staying closely aligned with leadership and peers.

 Execution-oriented, pragmatic, and hands-on.

 Open, direct, and collaborative in working across functions.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Retail Media)
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION 
 To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.
 What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.
 In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.
 And we’re a long way from done!

 THE OPPORTUNITY 
 Millions of people come to Carwow when they are ready to change their car. That is some of the highest-intent automotive audience in the UK, and it makes Carwow one of the most valuable places for dealers and manufacturers to reach buyers at the moment of decision. Retail media is how we turn that intent into revenue, for our partners and for the business.
 We have built the foundations: sponsored placements across the buying journey, a growing media and audience offering, and commercial products for dealers and manufacturers. Demand is ahead of what we can currently serve. If we can make our advertising products smarter, more relevant and easier to buy, we grow revenue for partners while keeping the experience useful for the consumer. That balance is the job.
 This role is the product voice for retail media: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with engineering, design, data and commercial teams to build it.
 This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Advertisers want smarter targeting, better recommendations on where to spend, and proof of what worked. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise.
 If you know retail media inside out, want to shape a fast-growing revenue line, and build things with a direct line to commercial outcomes, this is it.
  
 WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING 
 Product Strategy & Execution: 
 Set the product direction for Carwow's retail media products, defining what we build, in what order, and why

 Lead discovery with advertisers and internal teams: interviews, campaign data and marketplace analysis, to build a precise understanding of where we can add the most value

 Identify and test opportunities to bring AI into our advertising products: smarter targeting, relevancy and recommendations that actually change results Work in partnership with the Technical Engineering Manager and Designer, and collaborate with the engineers in your team, to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

 Manage the backlog with commercial awareness, prioritising work that drives revenue, advertiser performance and consumer relevance, not just activity

 
 Technical & Data Partnership: 
 Work closely with engineers on how ads are served, targeted, priced and measured, and make sound trade-offs between build, buy and integrate

 Own measurement: run controlled tests so every new placement or format proves its revenue impact without harming the consumer experience

 Use data directly, interrogating campaign and marketplace performance to guide decisions

 
 Cross-functional Leadership: 
 Work across product, engineering, commercial, campaign operations and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

 Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

 Support the commercial team in partner conversations where product context matters: capability deep-dives, roadmap discussions, strategic accounts

 
 
 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 
 Proven retail media experience is a prerequisite: you have built or owned sponsored ads, onsite media or audience products at a marketplace, retailer or ad tech business, and you know how the industry works

 5+ years of product management experience, with evidence of growing advertising revenue or advertiser performance

 Technically strong: you understand ad serving, targeting, auction and pricing mechanics, APIs and tracking, and can hold a credible conversation with engineers about architecture and trade-offs

 Comfortable with data: you interrogate performance data yourself, design your own tests, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for analysis to land in your inbox

 Great stakeholder skills: you build trust with commercial teams, technical partners, advertisers and senior leaders, push back when needed, and come with solutions rather than problems

 Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

 NICE TO HAVE

jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Product
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. 
 n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
 
 Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
 
 Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

 
That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register .
 
 We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
 
 Your main goal will be to lead n8n’s enterprise product strategy and build scalable monetisation infrastructure , turning complex enterprise needs into innovative, reusable capabilities while preserving the simplicity, flexibility, and product-led experience that make n8n successful.
 
To make this happen, you'll take ownership of four key areas:
 
 Shape our enterprise product vision and strategy
 Define and drive our enterprise product vision, translating the needs of builders, admins, and buyers across governance, security, compliance, scale, and reliability into reusable product capabilities.

 Identify new opportunities, make thoughtful product bets, and decide which customer requests to prioritise, decline, or transform into broader solutions rather than reacting to individual deals.

 Champion exceptional product craft, usability, and quality, balancing innovation with enterprise readiness and measuring success through adoption, time-to-value, retention, and expansion.

 

 Own and scale our monetisation infrastructure

 Partner with Growth, Finance, Sales, and self-serve product teams to inform pricing, packaging, and tiering decisions while maintaining clear ownership of product priorities and outcomes.

 Make strategic trade-offs between new commercial capabilities, foundational investments, and simplification, ensuring reliable, scalable infrastructure with clear dependencies and realistic delivery commitments.

 Partner closely with Engineering leadership to build ambitious yet achievable roadmaps, making informed decisions about scope, sequencing, architectural constraints, and technical dependencies.

 Balance new product capabilities with technical debt, platform investment, and reliability, establishing clear ownership, effective prioritisation, and strong collaboration between Product and Engineering.

 
 Be the strategic product partner to customers and commercial teams
 Build deep knowledge of our enterprise customers, personally leading senior-level roadmap conversations, understanding their evolving needs, and navigating complex product escalations.

 Act as a trusted product counterpart to Sales, Customer Success, Legal/Security, and partners, translating customer and commercial insights into strategic product decisions.

 Set clear expectations with commercial teams and customers, confidently challenging account-specific requests when needed and ensuring long-term product value drives prioritisation.

jobs.title: Lead Product Engineer | 36labs
jobs.description:
Role: Lead Product Engineer
 Company: 36 Labs 
 Location: London, on site four days a week. The office is on Baker Street and moves to Primrose Hill within a couple of months. London-based candidates only.
 Job Type: Full-time
 About 36 Labs
 36 Labs is an applied AI research firm in London. It is working on a gap in today's models: they are weak at creative decisions and at explaining why a decision was made. The team's thesis is that if you solve creativity in LLMs, you have largely solved what captures human attention.
 The product is a harness that sits over any frontier model, especially video generation models. It runs ideation, generation and distribution end to end. Content goes out to real audiences, and a data loop improves the harness over time.
 The company is profitable and works with Sony, Warner and Universal through bespoke marketing partnerships. Marketing is the proof of concept, not the destination. A B2C offering is due very soon. V3 of the harness is being released internally, and it is a big scope of work.
 The team is ten people, with four engineers working under a CTO who is still hands-on in the code. The seed round closes in the next couple of weeks. This is a new stage of growth, not a replacement hire.
 What you are expected to do:
 Own the upcoming B2C product end to end, from launch: an AI-native, customer-facing product where UX matters as much as the models behind it.

 Lead product engineering: make product calls with the founders, set the bar for how things get shipped, and help shape the team as it grows.

 Work across the stack on the harness and the products around it. The structure is flat, so engineers work on a bit of everything, depending on what is needed.

 Help build and ship on top of V3 of the harness as it moves from internal release into wider use.

 Take ownership of your pieces of work and move them forward with little hand-holding.

 Work closely with the CTO and the other engineers, and explain your ideas back to the team.

 What you need to succeed:
 You have four or more years of hands-on engineering experience, including in the AI-native era.

 You have owned something before, and you can point to it.

 You take the lead. You see what needs doing and start, without waiting to be told.

 You communicate well. You explain your thinking clearly and enjoy discussing it.

 You live in London and are happy to be in the office four days a week.

 You do not need visa sponsorship at this stage. The company cannot sponsor until about February next year. A visa that runs well past February is fine.

 You work with Python, TypeScript and Postgres, and you know LLM and generative model APIs and open-weight models.

 You build and run back-end systems in production, including deployment and operation. This is a strong plus.

 You keep up with the latest stacks, models and engineering practices, and you have side projects beyond your degree or day job.

 A degree in computer science, engineering, maths, stats or similar is a plus, and so is an MSc or PhD. The university matters little, and experience matters more.

 Experience in applied generative media or creative companies, such as Fal, is a plus. What you have built matters more than who you built it for.

 A notice period of one month is fine.

 What you get:
 A seed-stage company with a profitable track record since it began operating.

 A strong CV line, and the chance to learn a lot quickly.

 Clear room to grow into a more senior role. The long-term plan is for the CTO to move to strategy and the bigger picture.

 Work on a problem few companies are tackling, with an extremely high ceiling.

 Real clients from day one, including Sony, Warner and Universal.

 A small, flat team of ten, with direct access to the CTO and the founders.

 How to apply
 Send your LinkedIn profile or CV to Alexander at the agency. We start with a short screening call. After that, the process runs as follows. First, a first-round interview with Benedict, head of operations, covering your projects, CV and motivation. Second, a technical interview with the CTO of about half an hour. Third, a take-home technical assessment. If the team cannot decide between candidates, there may be a final onsite round where you work on something in front of the team. Strong candidates may go straight to the CTO.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Sales Enablement (AI & Research)
jobs.description:
Senior Product Marketing Manager, Sales Enablement (AI & Research)

Team: Marketing

  Prolific

Prolific isn’t just enabling AI innovation – we’re redefining it. While foundational AI technologies are becoming commoditized, Prolific’s human data infrastructure provides the high-quality, diverse data required to train the next generation of AI models. Through our platform, we empower researchers and companies to access a global, ethically curated participant base, ensuring cutting-edge AI research and training grounded in inclusivity and precision.

 

The role

This is a brand new role, and you’ll be the first person to do it at Prolific.

Right now, the insight that could help us win more deals is scattered. We have valuable learnings about why we win, why we lose, and why deals stall, but they aren’t turned into the pitch, proof and materials that sellers use every day. You’ll fix that. You’ll become the person who knows our market position inside out and turns it into tools that help sellers win.
This is a revenue role. It sits at the point where product marketing meets sales enablement, across both our AI and research businesses. You’ll dig into win-loss, competitive intelligence and customer proof, then turn it into pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, case studies and training that reps use on their next call. You’ll also help new AEs and SDRs get up to speed faster.

You’ll be measured on win rate, sales cycle length, rep ramp time and how well equipped our sellers are in front of a buyer.

Our AI PMM leads strategic lab and enterprise AI pursuits, and our vertical PMMs tailor messaging for specific audiences. You own the foundation they all build on: the shared, trusted system of resources every other deal runs on.

 

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 6+ years in an enablement-facing role (product marketing, sales enablement or competitive intelligence) at a B2B company
  • Experience enabling sellers across more than one product or product line, at a startup, scale-up or enterprise
  • Experience doing the full job, not just the final slides: you’ve gathered the data and insight yourself, then turned it into materials sellers use
  • Enablement you’ve built that measurably moved win rate, ramp time or deal velocity. You can show who used it and what changed
  • Hands-on experience running buyer interviews. You ask about past behaviour, not hypothetical opinions, and you can get a lost buyer to tell you the real reason
  • Comfort with data: you can pull from a CRM and call-intelligence tools, build an analysis or business case, and defend your conclusions
  • Clear writing for busy readers: short, specific and easy to act on

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
About the Position

We are looking for a highly-driven Technical Product Manager who can provide organisation and coordination support for our engineering initiatives. Technology is core to our business, and this role is an opportunity to work alongside our engineers as we build and optimise Jane Street’s trading technology.

You’ll draw from your technical background on a daily basis, leading projects through their entire lifecycle, including defining goals, developing timelines, tracking milestones, managing developer time, identifying risks, and coordinating with related teams. You’ll also communicate project schedules, priorities, and status updates to the larger organisation.

Strong communication skills and the ability to manage competing priorities will be necessary to collaborate across a wide range of teams at Jane Street—including developers, business teams, operations, support—as well as with external financial entities, to make sure each project is delivered on time and meets or exceeds stated goals and expectations.

We operate in a flexible problem-solving environment that encourages people to think outside the box when developing processes and tools for the project at hand. The person in this role needs to be a strategic thinker who considers the goals of the group and project when problem solving.

This role sits within Jane Street’s technology group which designs, deploys, and supports all of the infrastructure that underpins our trading activities. The scope of our systems is large, and you'll gain insight into a broad cross section of the global market as you work to improve them. To succeed in this role, you must enjoy working independently on small teams, learning on the fly, and making decisions that have a real and immediate impact on the firm.

At Jane Street, the “P” in TPM can mean a lot of different things. Depending on the team, the person, and the circumstances, you may find yourself anywhere on the spectrum from Product Manager to Program Manager. As a result, you’ll be most successful at Jane Street if you’re comfortable with that sort of ambiguity, and happy to roll your sleeves up and dig into the problem at hand, bringing whatever relevant skills you have to bear, whether through large-scale program management and coordination, product vision, business context, or anything else. That’s also why you’ll find a second job posting for “Technical Program Manager” elsewhere on the site that looks just like this one - feel free to apply to whichever you think fits your experience and interests better and we’ll make sure your profile ends up in the right pipeline. 

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or other technical field is preferred. However we're also excited to talk to people who have picked up technical know-how through industry experience
  • Experience working directly with engineering teams
  • Experience managing software development projects
  • Experience with project management planning tools (i.e., Jira, spreadsheets)
  • Ability to describe detailed problems with brevity and accuracy
  • Ability to handle competing priorities and to work effectively in a challenging and fast-paced environment
  • Strong organisational and time management skills
  • Fluency in English required

About Us

Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end global SaaS gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees, while driving measurable ROI.

We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. As a Product Manager at Reachdesk, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the Reachdesk Platform. You will be accountable for turning complex customer and business problems into software products that deliver measurable impact.

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you’ll lead product initiatives end-to-end,  from identifying and deeply understanding the right problems to solve, through discovery and delivery, to launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy, proactively building context across customers, the market, internal stakeholders, data, and technology to understand what Reachdesk needs to achieve its goals. You’ll also make sound decisions when the path forward isn’t obvious.

You’ll partner closely with Engineering and Design and work across the wider business to create alignment, communicate decisions clearly, and ensure what we build is successfully launched, adopted, and delivers the outcomes we set out to achieve.

If you enjoy solving difficult problems, taking ownership, and moving comfortably between customer, technical, and business conversations, you’ll thrive in this role.

  • Set product direction and priorities, bringing together company goals, internal stakeholder needs, customer insight, market context, data, and technical considerations to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.

  • Lead product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and solution definition through delivery, rollout, and iteration, partnering with Engineering to manage scope, make pragmatic trade-offs, and deliver valuable solutions at pace.
  • Make sound product decisions and trade-offs, balancing customer and business needs, commercial impact, user experience, and technical considerations while aligning the wider business on compromises, priorities, and expectations.
  • Develop product opportunities with external partners, building relationships with technology partners to uncover mutual opportunities, shape integrations, align roadmaps, and navigate the product and commercial considerations required to bring them to market.
  • Orchestrate successful launches and adoption, working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, Logistics, Finance, Legal, and other teams to ensure the business is ready and customers realise value from what we build.
  • Communicate with clarity throughout, ensuring leadership and teams across Reachdesk understand product decisions, progress, risks, changes, and results.

 

About you

  • You have a strong track record of owning B2B SaaS products end-to-end, from identifying the right problems through delivery, adoption, and measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • You’re a strong problem solver who gets to the root of complex problems, brings structure to ambiguity, and uses evidence and judgement to determine the right path forward.
  • You operate with independence and initiative: you seek out the customers, stakeholders, data, and context you need rather than waiting for direction, while staying anchored to Reachdesk’s goals and priorities.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - Booking Management
jobs.description:
Hi! 👋 I'm Sam , Engineering Manager for Team Booking Management at WeTravel.
 I joined WeTravel to help simplify how group travel businesses handle payments and bookings. Our Booking Management team owns the journey from the moment a traveler decides to book: checkout flows, order management, tax management, and everything that enables travelers to easily make a reservation and manage it afterwards. Last year alone, over a million travelers booked adventures through our platform! As we streamline and localize our booking experience, I'm looking for engineers who are excited about making complex booking and commerce flows feel simple for our global users.
 
 About WeTravel:
 Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.
 WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform makes it simple for organizers to create beautiful trip proposals, securely process payments, and manage their customers, so they can focus on what they do best: creating amazing experiences.
 This is one of the last great frontiers of travel to come online, and as the category leader, we are at the forefront of this change. Last year alone, our platform was trusted by 8,000 organizers to lead over a million travelers on adventures in 150+ countries. Now, we're on an exciting journey to grow from powering $1B to $10B in travel experiences per year.
 We believe that every trip, when done right, can be a force for good - and we're building the engine to make more of that possible.
 
 What's the role:
 You will join the Booking Management team to lead critical projects across checkout, order management, tax management, and traveler self-service. Upcoming work includes:
 Checkout experience: streamlining and localizing our checkout flows so travelers in every market can complete a reservation in just a few clicks.

 Order management: building the foundational systems for organizers and travelers to view, modify, and manage reservations end-to-end - changes, transfers, cancellations, and everything in between.

 Tax management: expanding our tax capabilities across jurisdictions so organizers can sell compliantly wherever their travelers are.

 Reliability and structural improvements: scaling our booking flows to support 10x growth.

 
 What you'll do day-to-day: 
 Lead booking projects end-to-end: discovery with Product and Customer teams, solution design, build, rollout, monitoring, and incident response.

 Partner with the Product team to gain insight into organizer and traveler challenges, building booking experiences that convert and delight.

 Own the reliability of our booking and order management systems

 Contribute to WeTravel's engineering practices and excellence.

 
 How we work:
 We're focused on the impact. We don't subscribe to any one framework or execution ideology, and we adapt based on what's impactful.

 We're using the latest hardware and constantly on the look out for better tools & ways to work.

 We have AI-first development experience and work with the latest models and agentic dev tools.

 Stack: We're developing React/TypeScript, Ruby on Rails and Kotlin Microservices. Our services run on Kubernetes. We also use and love MongoDB, MySQL, Postgres, Snowflake and we're working with the major LLM providers.

 
 You should apply if you have:
 
 Basic qualifications: 
 7+ years of product engineering expertise, with 4+ years dedicated to architecting complex e-commerce, booking, or order management systems.

 Proven track record within a high-scale consumer checkout, marketplace, travel, or e-commerce platform team.

 Broad practical expertise in building and troubleshooting production-level checkout and order flows: conversion-critical funnels, pricing and tax calculation, availability and inventory, cancellations, modifications, and refund flows. You possess deeply ingrained expertise in order state machines, multi-step form UX, and the operational tooling that keeps commerce systems running.

 Strong backend mastery in Ruby on Rails, Kotlin, Python, Go, Java, or Node.js with the agility to ramp up on Ruby quickly.

 Full-stack comfort: you can build the React interface for the booking flows you architect.

 Deep expertise in architecting robust, resilient distributed systems, including order and reservation state machines, idempotency, exactly-once semantics, event-driven architectures, webhooks, and reliable consumer patterns.

 Direct production on-call experience, including authoring post-mortems and leading incident response.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including cross-functional collaboration experience, and the ability to thrive in a distributed, multicultural e

jobs.description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!
 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the DODO team in the Platform domain .
 Your mission will be to build and maintain the common building blocks of Doctolib's system with a "Platform as a Product" mindset, abstracting and simplifying complex, critical data infrastructure so that product teams can focus on what matters: building faster, better products for healthcare professionals and patients. You will work closely with 600+ engineers across 70+ teams, owning the vision and strategy for data management products that form the foundation of everything we build.
 Working in the product team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We operate in feature teams within an agile environment, collaborating closely with engineering, design, and business teams.
 What you'll do
 Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:
 Own and align the 2-year vision for data storage at Doctolib, defining which datastore products we build, which we source off the shelf, and how they serve both the monolith and the growing ecosystem of services around it

 Define the product strategy and roadmap for data management products used by 600+ engineers, spanning multiple datastores (PostgreSQL/Aurora, Kafka, Debezium, Couchbase), file storage, data access, and data lifecycle solutions

 Drive reliability, recoverability, and cost transparency across teams, including SLOs, alert ownership, backup and restore testing, and per-team cost visibility

 Define the experience for managing production data for services outside the monolith and for new AI product storage needs

 Partner with Staff and Senior Staff Engineers to assess the impact of complex architectural decisions, facilitate consensus across diverse viewpoints, and align stakeholders on contested trade-offs

 Measure and improve engineer satisfaction with data management products, leading projects end-to-end, from problem definition and specs writing to development validation, rollout, and impact follow-up

 Who you are

 You'll be a great fit if you: 
 Have at least 5 years of experience in Product Management with direct product ownership, working with developers, leading rituals, and writing specifications

 Have extensive experience with technical products and platforms, and a passion for solving complex, large-scale infrastructure challenges

 Can drive change across large engineering organizations, you're comfortable influencing 600+ engineers across more than 70 teams

 Have proven experience building and launching products in a large-scale, international B2B environment, where moving fast without slowing down feature development is a constant challenge

 Are fluent in both English and French (C1 level minimum) and are comfortable working in an international environment

 Have an entrepreneurial mindset and the ambition to transform healthcare

jobs.description:

 Rattachée à l'équipe du Doctolib Assistant (notre chat IA), notre mission est stratégique : la base de connaissances que nous créons constitue la source d'information principale de cet assistant. Notre rôle est d'en assurer la richesse et l'exactitude afin de fournir à nos utilisateurs une qualité de réponse optimale. Nous travaillons tous avec un objectif commun et ambitieux : réduire le taux de contact tout en offrant la meilleure expérience utilisateur d'Europe.  
 En nous rejoignant, vous participerez au lancement de 100% des nouvelles fonctionnalités et nouveaux produits, en travaillant de concert avec la manager de l'équipe Selfcare France, pour accompagner cette révolution technologique. Pour effectuer vos missions, vous interagirez avec l'ensemble des équipes produit cross countries : Product Managers, Product Marketing Managers et AI Trainers.
  
 Vos missions 
 Vos responsabilités seront réparties sur deux grands axes :
 Le cœur de métier (Run & Qualité des contenus) : 
 Rédiger des articles de FAQ de qualité en français et en anglais afin d’apporter des explications claires à nos utilisateurs sur le fonctionnement de nos produits.

 Assurer la fiabilité des réponses du Doctolib Assistant via l'analyse des feedbacks, et œuvrer à son amélioration en synergie avec les AI Trainers.

 Définir le plan d'accompagnement "in-product" en collaboration avec les équipes PM et PMM afin d'apporter le bon niveau d'explication aux utilisateurs et anticiper leurs questions.

 Les Projets IA & L'Amélioration continue : 
 Participer activement à des projets IA innovants pour accompagner la transformation de notre métier et de nos processus internes.

 Utiliser l’IA comme un levier pour optimiser la rédaction de contenus et gagner en efficacité dans la production de nos supports.

 Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de notre ligne directrice et du ton de la voix, notamment pour les rendre encore plus "AI readable".

 Analyser la performance et l’impact des projets mis en place via des KPIs, identifier des plans d’action et les implémenter.

 Avez une forte affinité pour le produit et un réel intérêt pour son fonctionnement et son évolution.

 Faites preuve d'une rigueur et d'une structure implacables dans votre travail au quotidien.

 Êtes doté(e) d'un fort esprit critique et d'analyse (indispensable pour challenger, vérifier et prendre du recul sur le contenu généré par l'IA).

 Faites preuve d'une grande curiosité pour l'IA et avez très envie d'explorer l'utilisation d'outils d'IA générative au quotidien pour transformer votre façon de travailler.

 Avez un véritable état d'esprit "learn" : vous avez soif d'apprendre, envie d'évoluer et de monter en compétences avec humilité.

 Maîtrisez l'anglais (écrit et oral) , une compétence indispensable pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.

 Ce serait fantastique si :

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Product Led Growth- Nantes (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare! 
 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Product team at Doctolib.
 Your mission: scale Doctolib's acquisition engine into a measurable, lower-cost growth driver across France, Germany and Italy. You will own the end-to-end product-led and marketing-led growth funnel, from freemium offer design to subscription and in-product upsell, contributing directly to growing ARR while bringing the cost to acquire new practitioners down.
 Building at Doctolib means shipping products that change how care teams and patients experience healthcare every day.
  
 
What you'll do 
 Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:
 Own Doctolib freemium offer: define what is free, metered, or demo-only, and design the conversion paths that move practitioners to a paid plan

 Own and improve the subscription funnel for new business and upsell, across web and in-product surfaces, including checkout and sign-up unification

 Design and improve every in-product flow that moves an existing customer to a higher-value plan

 Define acquisition-side packaging: offer catalogue, eligibility rules, and contract signature flows across France, Germany and Italy

 Lead marketing-led growth initiatives, including lead generation, B2B website conversion, and lifecycle marketing, connecting them to the core product funnel

 Set the direction for cross-team delivery (along with the PMMs and other counterparts), deciding offer by offer and country by country when conversion is the right path, and when to route a user to sales as a warm, product-qualified lead

  
 
Who you are 
 Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.
  
 You'll be a great fit if you: 
 You have owned a PLG conversion, ARR or CAC metric as your primary objective in B2B SaaS at scale, and can quantify what it moved, from what baseline, over what period

 You have scaled product-led growth alongside a sales motion, and can explain how you chose between autonomous conversion and handing sales a warm lead, offer by offer

 You read data yourself, define funnel measurement from scratch, and make decisions with experiments rather than opinion

 You have solid product judgement on pricing, packaging, eligibility and freemium boundaries, and can work within a regulated environment with consent and country-specific constraints in mind

 You set direction for teams you do not manage and move a metric across a cross-functional chain

 You are fluent in English

  
 It would be fantastic if you: 
 Have owned both product-led and marketing-led growth, connecting lifecycle, attribution or lead scoring to the product funnel

 Have worked across multiple countries with different pricing or packaging constraints

 Have experience in a regulated or healthcare context

  
 
What we offer 
 Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

 Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

 Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

 Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
Head of Product 
 
 Preferred starting date: ASAP
 Weekly availability: Full-time (40 hours/week)
 Location: Delft, the Netherlands (hybrid
 Report to: CEO

 
 About the company 
 Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.
 Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.
 We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.
 
 Your role 
 As Head of Product, you own our product hands-on. You are the bridge between what the market and our operators need and what we build, turning field feedback and market insight into a clear roadmap and products people actually want to use. You own how our capabilities become real products: how they are shaped, packaged, priced, taken to market, and adopted by the people who use them in the field.
 This is a hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves role, not a purely strategic one. You set the product’s direction together with the founders, and you do the work to make it happen: talking to users, writing requirements, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to ship. You bring structure to how we do product without turning it into bureaucracy.
 You will work closely with the founders, engineering, and commercial. The company strategy is set with the founders; your job is to own the product within it and make it succeed.
 
 Your responsibilities will include 
 • Product strategy & roadmap. Owning the product roadmap and prioritization, and keeping the product direction aligned with the company strategy as the market and the technology evolve.
 • Market-to-technical bridge. Translating operator needs, market signals, and partner requirements into clear, well-scoped work for engineering, and translating technical capability back into value the market understands.
 • Hands-on product delivery. Writing requirements, shaping features, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to get things shipped and validated.
 • Product portfolio. Helping shape how our capabilities in detection, navigation, interception, and beyond fit together as a modular, scalable line-up rather than isolated tools.
 • User experience & adoption. Owning how usable our products are for end users: ease of use, onboarding, training, documentation, and the adoption path from first deployment to routine operational use.
 • Pricing & business model. Contributing to pricing, packaging, and business models across the product line-up, and owning the product side of the classic marketing mix (the 4Ps).
 • Go-to-market. Partnering with commercial and business development on go-to-market for each capability, from positioning and narrative to capability briefs and demos.
 • Market intelligence. Keeping an eye on the market: trends, competitors, adjacent opportunities, and where the next product bets should be.
 • Regulatory & compliance awareness. Given the defence context, factoring export control, procurement, and relevant standards into product decisions, working with the right internal and external stakeholders.
 • Lightweight product practices. Bringing just enough structure, process, and documentation to make product work repeatable, suited to a fast-moving deep-tech company.
 
 What you will deliver in your first year 
 • A clear, documented product roadmap, aligned with the founders and understood across the company.
 • A working feedback loop that turns field and operational insight into product decisions.
 • Well-scoped, prioritized work flowing to engineering, with product shipped and validated with users.
 • Input into pricing and business-model choices for the core product lines.
 • A joint go-to-market plan with commercial for at least one capability, taken through to execution.
 • Measurable improvement in product adoption and usability through better onboarding, documentation, and training f

jobs.title: Senior Influencer Marketing Project Manager
jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Ben jij de influencer-goeroe die wij zoeken?

Volg jij de nieuwste features op Instagram, TikTok, YouTube en Snapchat op de voet? Weet jij precies welke influencers op dit moment hot zijn? Beheers je zowel het Nederlands als het Engels vloeiend? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Over WPP Media

WPP Media is een dochteronderneming van WPP, het wereldwijde advertisingconglomeraat. We ondersteunen toonaangevende mediabureaus zoals Wavemaker, Mindshare en EssenceMediacom. Binnen WPP Media zijn verschillende centrale activiteiten ondergebracht, waaronder StudioM, Digital Data Hub, Business Intelligence, Proces Management, Marketing Services & Insights, Trading en Quality Management.

WPP Media is een dynamische, jonge en ambitieuze organisatie met duizenden (young) professionals wereldwijd. In Nederland hebben we kantoren in Amsterdam, Eindhoven en Sittard. Daar werken honderden collega’s voor toonaangevende klanten zoals Action, Lamb Weston, NS, Subway, M&M’s, Brabantia, IKEA en Dr. Oetker.

Ons kantoor in Amsterdam biedt een adembenemend uitzicht van 180 graden over de stad en de Amstel. De sfeer is informeel en gezellig, met regelmatig vrijdagmiddagborrels in onze skybar op de negende verdieping.

Over StudioM en de functie

Je gaat aan de slag bij StudioM, ons interne bureau voor influencer marketing. We voeren campagnes uit op grote, vaak internationale schaal. Je werkt met een breed scala aan klanten, influencers en campagnes, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is.

In deze rol draag je zelfstandig de operationele verantwoordelijkheid voor complexe en omvangrijke projecten. Denk aan multi-marketprojecten, strategische accounts, campagnes voor meerdere merken en innovatieve trajecten.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Projectmanagement: Je bent zelfstandig verantwoordelijk voor het opzetten, uitvoeren en coördineren van influencer marketingcampagnes.
  • Planning en voortgang: Je stuurt de dagelijkse uitvoering aan, maakt duidelijke projectplanningen en bewaakt deadlines, afhankelijkheden, prioriteiten en de voortgang van projecten.
  • Influencerselectie en briefings: Je vertaalt de kaders en briefings van de accountmanager naar concrete selectielijsten, taken en creatieve briefings, waaronder influencerbriefings. Waar nodig verdeel je taken onder junior collega’s of stagiairs.
  • Relatiebeheer en onderhandelingen: Je onderhoudt relaties met influencers en talentbureaus en onderhandelt zelfstandig over marktconforme vergoedingen binnen het vastgestelde budget.
  • Budgetbeheer en administratie: Je beheert projectbudgetten en houdt kosten bij, zoals influencer fees, buy-outs en event- en productiekosten. Ook verzorg je contracten en regel je boekingen met bureaus.
  • Content en kwaliteit: Je bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van alle content en deliverables, voert eerste contentchecks uit en werkt nauw samen met accountmanagers richting definitieve goedkeuring.
  • Afstemming en rapportage: Je werkt samen met interne teams om effectieve campagnes te realiseren. Je houdt klanten, stakeholders en de accountmanager proactief op de hoogte van de dagelijkse voortgang, sluit waar nodig aan bij klantupdates en rapporteert over resultaten en aandachtspunten.
  • Risicobeheersing en optimalisatie: Je signaleert risico’s, knelpunten en optimalisatiemogelijkheden, bespreekt deze met de (senior) accountmanager en escaleert tijdig waar nodig. Je stuurt actief bij, optimaliseert lopende campagnes en voert verbeteringen door met medior- en juniorcollega’s.
  • Evaluatie en begeleiding: Je levert inhoudelijke input voor projectevaluaties, vertaalt learnings naar verbeteringen voor toekomstige campagnes en begeleidt en werkt stagiairs in binnen het team.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt een passie voor influencer marketing en leeft social media. Je kijkt liever YouTube en TikTok dan televisie en denkt in Instagram Stories.
  • Je volgt de nieuwste features en ontwikkelingen op socialmediaplatformen en weet welke influencers op dit moment relevant zijn.
  • Je begrijpt hoe platformen als Face
